headerText: Spend your {budget} trait points. Drawbacks pay points back.
incompatibleNote: Clashes with a trait you have already taken.
unaffordableNote: Not enough trait points left for this one.
packsHint: A package is a starting point: switch to Detailed mode to add, remove or replace any of its traits.

soldier.name: Old Soldier
soldier.description: Years under arms, a flat voice and a habit that came home with them.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: A brilliant, well-read mind that has spent too long too close to the page.

outlaw.name: Outlaw
outlaw.description: Light fingers, lighter scruples, and a name somebody is still looking for.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Herbs, patience and a refusal to raise a hand to anyone.

mystic.name: Mystic
mystic.description: Born to the work, versed in the still, and careful about omens.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Built for it, trained for it, and quick to find a reason.

noble.name: Noble Born
noble.description: A house, an inheritance and a manner that opens doors.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: Reads the land, follows a track and never loses the way home.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: A steady eye, a fast hand and very little hesitation.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim
pilgrim.description: A road walked for a creed, and a creed carried quietly.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: A voice that carries, a taste for pleasure and a way with an audience.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: A nose for a price, an eye on the ladder and a tongue that closes deals.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.description: Marked, scarred and out of favour with whoever is meant to be listening.

tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
tinkerer.description: Forge, workbench and a working day nobody else would keep.
